title: Item/quest hint text in the inventory list does not clear once its prompted action is actually completed, so it keeps telling you to do something you already did. Confirmed twice: 'lean wolf's pelt' and 'gaunt rib-bone' still showed '(the hunter might want to see it)' in a status check well after I had shown both to the hunter; 'the true pardon, unsent' still showed '(...read it where the Company can hear it)' in the status check taken immediately after I had already read it aloud over the Hanged Company.
where: status screen / carrying list, Hunter's Camp and Gallows Glade items
